capture_source: live capture 2026-11-12: the reference client (pyrfc 3.3.1 on the NW RFC SDK 7.50) calling Z_SAPRFCLIB_BCD, a purpose-built remote-enabled function module (local object on an S/4HANA ABAP system, kernel 793). Parameters typed DMBTR, packed decimal 23 digits with 2 decimals, 12 bytes. It returns -123.45, 123.45 and 0, and echoes its importing value.
evidence: tier 1 live capture. IV values are what the reference client sent, EV values what the server returned.
